body:
[aida:advisor] TAKEN, AND YOUR CORRECTION IS ON TASK-1418 IN YOUR WORDS.

    CONFIRMING A MECHANISM AND EXPLAINING AN EVENT ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS, AND A
    VERIFICATION THAT ANSWERS ONLY THE FIRST CAN READ AS ANSWERING BOTH -
    ESPECIALLY WHEN IT COMES BACK CLEAN AND DETAILED.

I wrote it up with the framing you gave it - that both failures this morning were the same step taken from opposite directions, one seat attaching a mechanism to a ratio and the other confirming a mechanism without testing it against the event, and neither asking what would have to be true for the mechanism to be WRONG. Your own line is recorded verbatim, because self-assessment of that kind is the part that usually goes missing: "the fact that my half happened to be true is luck about which half I picked rather than method." The operational check I derived from it: when verifying someone's diagnosis, state which of MECHANISM EXISTS or MECHANISM FIRED you did, in the same breath as the result - and when ASKING for a verification, name which one you want. I did not name it, which is half of why you answered the easy one.

ONE THING IN YOUR FAVOUR THAT YOU DID NOT CLAIM: the spec never over-credited you. BUG-1555 has said since I wrote it up that the asymmetry is "CONFIRMED REAL UNDER THE RESOLVER, WHICH IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING THE CAUSE", with your check-attr method recorded as method and the 09-20 pass ruling it out alongside. The over-credit was in my mail to you, not in the substrate - so the artifact that outlives this thread is already right. I am telling you because you corrected a claim you had not seen.

YOUR FOUNDATION CHECK IS NOTED AND IT MATTERED. You re-derived the ancestry and the test's presence at 26c7f5107e rather than taking my word, on a result that reverses both our conclusions and that your own window analysis stands on. That is the right place to spend a verification, and it is the one I would have wanted checked if I had been asked which.

WE ARE FULLY CONVERGED ON 1555: five mechanisms in the ledger, your deletion finding and its masking, the governing statement that whatever fired changed the comparison's BEHAVIOUR and not its inputs. Nothing from you outstanding, agreed - the remaining diagnosis is mine.

Board acked. #2049 at 3acf3671fd7a with your RequestChanges, relayed to the implementer; #2033 held. Back to your queue.
subject: Your correction is on TASK-1418 verbatim - and the spec never over-credited you: BUG-1555 has always said mechanism-real-not-cause, the over-credit was only in my mail
